title: ANDS Studio — Operations (registry, portfolio, correspondence, audit)
walkthrough:
You open the Portfolio page under the top navigation bar (subtitle "portfolio"). The "Portfolio" heading sits above "Every product dossier in your organisation — module progress, filing gate and fee status at a glance," then a smaller note that every change is captured in the dossier's append-only audit trail — actor and workspace stamped, sequence-numbered, exportable for inspections (open a dossier → Audit). With no dossiers you see "No dossiers yet." and a link to create one in the dossier manager.

The FIRST control is a "Client / sponsor" scope card: a selector defaulting to "All sponsors in this workspace," a green "Scope: … · N" chip, and a collapsed "How isolation works" expander that, when opened, explains the workspace is the hard tenant boundary (cross-workspace reads refused at the API), sponsor scope is a within-workspace filter, and role-based visibility. Below it an "Export client status report (CSV)" button; then three summary cards — Dossiers, Ready to file, Blocked. If any dossier has a deadline within 30 days or overdue, a "⏳ N dossiers with a deadline in the next 30 days" card lists linked dossier chips (soonest first, an optional "N overdue" chip).

A "Show / Hide dossier grid (N)" toggle sits above the grid, which is open by default. Each row shows the dossier ID, title, submission type (plus "· CS-BE" if applicable); an Owner / Client / Due column (missing values read "—" or "none set," the client name carrying a shield icon); a mini module tower; and ONE primary status chip — "Ready to file," "N/N modules," or "Blocked." A quiet per-row "Details" expander holds the fee chip, any litigation clock ("⏱ NOA: Nd for brand to act" or "stay: Nd remaining," each with a "ⓘ prov" popover), and collaboration chips. Links "Open →" and "Viewer" end the row.

The Registry page ("Product registry") shows a "Workspace: … · isolated" shield chip and a "Register product +" toggle. A "Record only." notice states registering or changing status logs a record in your workspace and does not transmit or file anything with Health Canada. The form asks for Product name, Dossier ID, DIN (8 digits, live validation — blank reads "Issued by Health Canada at NOC — leave blank until then"), Country, and Drug type. When any registration is marketable a "Right-to-Sell deadlines" card lists per-DIN due dates (October 1, overdue flagged) each with a provenance popover. An "Annual notification checklist" (current year) records who signed each tick and when; ticked items strike through with a "✓ signed by … · UTC" line.

The Correspondence page ("Correspondence & notices") opens with the same "Record only." notice and Client / sponsor scope card, then a "Dossier" field (placeholder "e123456") that only offers dossiers in scope. Until you pick one: "Pick a dossier in the selected client / sponsor scope…." Once picked, a "Notice inbox" (ingest an SDN/SAL/SRL/NOD/NON/NOC, advancing the DSTS lifecycle and surfacing the response window; a "Start lifecycle" form if none exists) and a "Correspondence hub" (logged records with a kind filter and "Log correspondence +") stack. The "Form V / NOA register" sits behind a collapsed "Advanced" expander; its statutory clocks each carry a "· calculated aid" stamp and provenance popover.

Opening any dossier's Audit page shows the "Audit Trail" — the durable, append-only Part-11 record, newest first, with Refresh and "Export audit report (CSV)." Each event shows a category chip, action, sequence number, timestamp, a "by" actor chip and a compact detail line; a footer counts events, noting they are mirrored to the central governance trail.
